title: Associativity of canonical unbounded derived direct image comparisons
statement: Fix unbounded derived categories of module sheaves on every scheme [def-pc-derived-category] and derived direct images [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Suppose c(f,g): Rg_* composed with Rf_* is isomorphic to R(gf)_* for all scheme morphisms and its inverse satisfies the pasted right-derived unit equation. For composable f, g, h, the path Rh_*(c(f,g)) followed by c(gf,h) and the transport along associativity of scheme morphisms equals the path c(g,h) evaluated after Rf_* followed by c(f,hg), componentwise at every derived object.

source.place: Tag 0D5T (Lemma 20.28.2), coherence expanded using the universal property of the construction in Tag 079V

proof.text: take inverses of the two composite isomorphisms from Rf Rg Rh to R(hgf). Precompose their natural transformations with the derived unit for the triple composite. Apply hc twice on each side. Naturality of the derived unit for h moves the unit for f past the middle comparison. Functoriality and associativity of composition then make both results the same triple pasted unit: the unit for h at g applied to f applied to K, followed by Rh of the unit for g at f applied to K, followed by Rh Rg of the unit for f at K. The underived direct-image associator agrees in the two paths, since its maps on sections are the canonical scalar-restriction and inverse-image identifications. Uniqueness of transformations out of the right derived functor of hgf gives equality of the inverse transformations. Inverting, then evaluating at E, proves the displayed formula; eqToHom records the equality between the two composite scheme morphisms.

theorem derivedDirectImageComposition_associativity
    [d : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (c : ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
      schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage g ≅
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ≫ g))
    (hc : ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
        (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)),
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (f ≫ g).toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K ≫
          (c f g).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K) =
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
            (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomotopyCategory
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).map
            ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K)) :
    ∀ {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : W ⟶ X) (g : X ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ Z)
      (E : schemeDerivedCategory W),
      (schemeDerivedDirectImage h).map ((c f g).hom.app E) ≫
          (c (f ≫ g) h).hom.app E ≫
          eqToHom (congrArg (fun k : W ⟶ Z => (schemeDerivedDirectImage k).obj E)
            (Category.assoc f g h)) =
        (c g h).hom.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj E) ≫
          (c f (g ≫ h)).hom.app E
